items.q: that’s where Grace’s apartment was. I used to live there.

ctx.x: Right. 7th – one is Georgia Avenue, and then 7th Street.

Yeah, right in that immediate area. Right around – you walk out of the Howard Theater, turn left, go to the street, the first street, and turn left, and that’s where Grace’s apartment was. I used to live there.
I see a bunch of pictures of you at Ellington’s birthday party at . . .
